Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the attached approved Rabbit Royale shop design. This is the approved art direction and must be faithfully retained: warm honey-colored carved oak market stall, cream and orange striped canopy, brass hardware, moss-green selected controls, late afternoon golden lighting, lush foliage at edges, harbor and stone ruins behind, rich handcrafted pixel-art texture, charming small square-bodied rabbits. Preserve its color palette, camera angle, materials, framing, coherent pixel density, screen ratio and craft quality. Landscape 16:9, one complete game screen, no device mockup, no multiple versions. This will be implemented as separate Godot UI layers like the existing settings menu, with real buttons and localized live labels; keep strong readable organization and consistent component shapes.
Create the ITEMS page of this very same shop. Keep SHOP heading, carrot purse "1 240" and close X in the same top locations. Keep category navigation "PACKS", "ITEMS", "SKINS", with ITEMS selected green and the other two brown. Payment selector remains "CARROTS", "USDC", "SOL", "SKR", CARROTS selected.
Replace bundle cubbies and the bottom skin showcase with a coherent set of SEVEN single-item displays on TWO rows of shelf compartments, four above and three below centered. Every item has its own clearly isolated large sprite, small parchment name label, an owned-count badge, one price button with carrot icon. The layout must feel spacious, organized, usable in landscape on a phone, consistent with the reference cabinet rather than generic rectangles.
Exact content: upper row "ENERGY" green/gold round medallion with a wooden center (not a lightning bolt), stock "2/20", price "700"; "BOMB" black round bomb with short unlit fuse, stock "3/20", price "150"; "LIGHTNING" yellow lightning bolt, stock "0/20", price "500"; "SHIELD" blue white shield, stock "4/20", price "600". Lower row "BLOOP" small purple squid icon, stock "0/20", price "100"; "FENCE" rustic wooden fence section, stock "4/20", price "300"; "SMOKE" soft pale smoke puff, stock "OFF", price "2 000". Show concise one-line purposes if space permits, but prioritize large icon and legible name/stock/price.
Absolutely no rabbit characters packaged with the individual items, no pack discounts, no x3 or x10 packs, no skins in the item shelves. Small quiet footer "Saved in your bag". Produce a beautiful plausible actual game UI, closely matching the approved design.

Keep it as readable and structured as a polished settings screen, not a dense shop shelf. Strong artwork, warm forest light, handcarved frames and cloth-lined cubbies, literal pixel-game charm. No packs and no solo consumables on this page.
